title: MarketAnalyzerItems
description: Shape of content.items for L1-vision-market-analyzer. items carries META POINTS about market-analysis.md, not the full document — the complete competitor matrix and SWOT narrative live ONLY in the artifact, saved to s3 (blob storage). 'summary' fields are short distillations (<=~15 words); a consumer needing full detail retrieves the artifact. Citation, id, status, and confidence fields are structural, not prose duplication, and stay in full — gr-L1-citation-verifier is a BLOCKER guardrail here, not advisory.
